title: Samba Stings
description: Various 2-4 second stings based on "Modern Jazz Samba".

title: Sancho Panza gets a Latte
description: Acoustic guitar, latin percussion, bass, alto flute, trumpet, and... accordion. Sort of Spanish, sort of French.

title: Sapphire Isle
description: Arpeggiation and scales in an unusual chordal setting.

title: Sardana
description: Intimate guitar dance piece, probably too rubato to be an actual Sardana, but it didn't sound enough like a Farruca to call it that. "Vaguely Spanish Guitar Music" also seemed wrong.

title: Satiate
description: I piece unlike anything I've done, this is a very difficult piece to process emotionally. It just never lets the audience rest. There are a lot of uses for this sort of piece.  It is also available with just the percussion, and just the strings... both of which are quite differen

title: Satiate - only percussion
description: Highly effected percussion piece at a mid tempo. This track was extracted from a larger work, but will lend some motion and reserved immediacy to any scene.

title: Satiate - only strings
description: I piece unlike anything I've done, this is a very difficult piece to process emotionally. It just never lets the audience rest. There are a lot of uses for this sort of piece.  It is also available with percussion, which gives it a more immediacy.

title: Sauropod Spotting
description: This piece is one of three pieces that was inspired by a trip to a dinosaur-themed roadside attraction that had "dinosaur music". That music was recorded in the early 1990s, and sounds a bit cheesy today, so I tried to update it. This piece is a hybrid of triggered samples and li

title: Savannah (Sketch)
description: This is NOT a complete piece. It is only a sketch developed as a test for a stage production (repeated many times).  If you only need a few seconds, it is fine. Loping feel in 3/4 time.

title: Sax, Rock, and Roll
description: Lots of guitars with a sax-y hook.

title: Scattershot
description: Fast tempo and loose timing gives this piece some not-quite-in-control speed.

title: Scheming Weasel (faster version)
description: Sort of cartoonish, and yet sort of dark. I couldn't decide the tempo, so I posted a slower and faster version of the piece.

title: Scheming Weasel (slower version)
description: Sort of cartoonish, and yet sort of dark. I couldn't decide the tempo, so I posted a slower and faster version of the piece.

title: Scissors
description: Subtle atmospheric sounds and rain-like cymbal elements blend together, creating an aura of intensity and intrigue, suitable for a mysterious or suspenseful production. The sounds build in force just before the end.

title: SCP-x1x (Gateway to Hell)
description: Some nice soul-sucking horror music. It looks like an innocent birthday cake. Something mom might buy down at the Jewel’s. It showed up at the holiday party for our Class D personnel last year, but no one knows who brought it. It may be related to SCP-1117. Here’s the problem; yo

title: SCP-x2x (Unseen Presence)
description: Dark horror soundscape. There are places of evil in the world. Dark places. There are places that absorb life with their greasy tendrils of unlight. There are places that screw up everyone's sandwiches. There are places that delay postal packages. There are places that cause inte

title: SCP-x3x (I am Not OK)
description: Dark horror soundscape with technological and mechanical overtones.

title: SCP-x4x (Mind Leech)
description: Grating Horror Soundscape. Welcome to the Open House! I’m Kathy, your realtor. You’ll probably want to keep your shoes on. On your left is the living room, complete with ornate working fireplace. It’s fueled by the souls of the damned AND it heats the whole house! Mind yourself a

title: SCP-x5x (Outer Thoughts)
description: Nice, but creepy music for storytelling. Simple melodies played on that old piano your grandma had in her basement. It was once great, but has since become a spider and dust motel. I'm sure the spiders think it is pretty great. Gotta be loud if you're a piano spider, but rent con

title: SCP-x6x (Hopes)
description: Haunting music for storytelling; With a cello. Cello, bassoon, and piano are known to be expert haunters. This piece has no bassoon, but 2 out of 3 does get pretty haunting!

title: SCP-x7x (6th Floor)
description: Somewhat urgent music for storytelling. Winding staircase that leads to nowhere... like your liberal arts degree. Melodic enough to hold your interest. Repetitive enough for you to lose interest.

title: Screen Saver
description: Blip bloop?  Bloopity BlooBlip! BlooBlip?! Blibbity blib blib blib! Blip bloop. Blippity bloop bloop BLOOP! :-)

title: Second Coming - no percussion
description: A loop-based piece, I've gotten a lot of requests for a version of this with no percussion or voice - so here you go. Broad and inspiring.

title: Secret of Tiki Island
description: Co-written with Bryan Teoh while he was on vacation (Thanks Bryan!) this is all the mystery and chill groove you need. So come on you cats and swingers, enjoy yourself a Jet Pilot (served in a pineapple of course) and help unravel the Secret of Tiki Island! Can you save yourself

title: Secrets of the Schoolyard
description: Sort of dark and mysterious, while still being current-sounding and light. Got a mystery in the city? I got your music! Crazy deep bass in lots of parts… careful when mixing this one.

title: Semi-Funk
description: Horn Section with a couple of solos. Nice hook, and the upright bass is beautiful.

title: Senbazuru
description: Beautiful warm and calming piece with a Japanese sort of sound. A low end synth provides deep support.

title: Send for the Horses
description: Floaty! Ethereal! Useful for dream sequences. Or those montages of sad people standing in the rain.

title: Serene
description: A slow, very calm piece featuring English horn, piano, and bass. Center section also has brass ensemble and strings.

title: Sergio's Magic Dustbin
description: This piece starts very slow and builds... like Bolero. Unlike Bolero, this piece builds beyond the safety limit and gets crazy. I recommend you check out the piece from 1 minute 48 seconds in. There are several break points you can start from to get to the crazy payoff faster, or

title: Serpentine Trek
description: Something winding its way somewhere.

title: Seven March
description: A piece in 7/8 time with 2-measure phrasing. Very dark and round sounding with randomly placed percussions.

title: Seven Off
description: Lots of strings, a couple of winds carry the interest offset by a glockenspiel. 7-4 time. Slow and unnerving.

title: Seventh Seal
description: Simple drone followed by a crescendo leading to silence.

title: Severe Tire Damage
description: Ultra-cool downtempo piece with faster driving percussions. Want to look cool? Make this your theme song. Play it loud enough and you can use it for pro-wrestling entrance music! Uncompressed download comes with a bonus 96bpm set.

title: Shades of Spring
description: Sort of a minor mid-tempo jazz combo with 2 pianos. Melody is doubled in octaves. Soloist goes outside more than the guy comping... but hey - what are soloists for?

title: Shadowlands 1 - Horizon
description: Part one of seven. Sort of an edgy-underwater feel... which isn't common. You can feel the struggle just trying to get the sounds out. Imagine a small rhinoceros at a tea party. The image you have in your head has nothing to do with this piece; But it is quite amusing.

title: Shadowlands 2 - Bridge
description: Part two of seven. Very close clusters of tones bring the tension! And that tension wanes and waxes without notice. If you want your audience to be concerned, this is how you do it.

title: Shadowlands 3 - Machine
description: Part three of seven. Part pipe organ, part broken pipe organ, this isn't just spooky, it is crazy spooky. It also has a musical theme, which not all of this horror moody stuff has. Consider it the jelly filling in your horror doughnut.

title: Shadowlands 4 - Breath
description: Part four of seven. This is the pizza cutter of this series, round and edgy. It has a little bit of melodic complexity, but mostly it just sits around being creepy. Should work well under dialog.

title: Shadowlands 5 - Antechamber
description: Part five of seven. Airy, but not in the "I'm outdoors, and everything is great 'airy'" way. More like the "the alien machine that sustains our life is slowly breaking down and poison is beginning to seep from its core" way. Whatever is happening... it isn't fast, and it isn't go

title: Shadowlands 6 - The Pit
description: Part alien cacophony, part organic awfulness, part six of seven. If you set this piece as music you wake up to in the morning, you're going to have a bad, bad day. There will be half remembered monsters from the times of not-asleep, not-awake... whose only jobs are to induce unex

title: Shadowlands 7 - Codex
description: Part seven of seven. A real mind bender. This one is all acoustic, and no artificial synths, so it has an organic feel. Not Certified Organic, just normal organic. So, that means it looks better, requires less fertilizer, has fewer pests and a higher yield.

title: Shamanistic
description: Earthy, yet unearthly. Deep and rich with things amiss.

title: Shaving Mirror
description: Hey, yo - welcome to the sic'est grammar podcast on the planet, where your future will have been perfectly continuous. I can't really think up much more in the realm of grammar jokes without going to the "dangling participle". And that's not happening.

title: Sheep May Safely Graze - BWV 208
description: Bach. Abnormal instrumentation.

title: Shenyang
description: When I do music based on folk traditions, I tend to name them after cities. Like this one: Shenyang. It is a little village of 8 million people that I've somehow never heard of. Oh sure, I've heard the name, but I don't associate it with anything specific. Chicago: Hot Dogs. Amst

title: Shiny Tech
description: Electronica (techo-pop dance). This is a fast and energetic piece polished almost to a fault. Lots of synth, and a happy clave. Think fashion show runway. Works best loud, works also not so loud.

title: Shiny Tech II
description: Electronica (techo-pop dance). Much like its predecessor, but with a brand new, less pop main synth line.

title: Shores of Avalon
description: Highly processed piano with lots of subtle synths and vocal effects. Grows in intensity after the 3 minute mark, then calms again.

title: Show Your Moves
description: Your toe will start tapping to the bump of the bass drum once the music pans through your speakers.  This song is one for a successful accomplishment or the happy ending to a difficult challenge.  The staccato melody resembles a synthesized tremolo violin, while the bass guitar t

title: Showdown
description: Starts unnerving; ends calming.

title: Sidewalk Shade
description: Just a nice little jazz piece. A slower version is also available.

title: Sidewalk Shade - slower
description: Just a nice little jazz piece. A faster version is also available.

title: Silly Fun
description: This is a set of 2 happy bubble-gummy themes for a comic platformer-type video game. Also included in the mp3 file are three different endings - quick, longer, and other.

title: Silver Blue Light

title: Silver Flame
description: Life is the source of mystical potential. Or it isn't. One of the two. If I had to bet... I would probably ask what those words mean. Even 'life' isn't simple. I don't think I could recognize what the first living thing was. It is like making a soup. Hot water? Not soup. Hot wate

title: Simple Duet
description: Slower, optimistic and simple duet.

title: Simple Music to Frighten Small Children By
description: If the title doesn't say it... The sound was accomplished by recording a piano, doubling the recording and pitching one down almost an octave while pitching the other up almost an octave.

title: Simplex
description: Thin, dark, moody piece that accelerates to the end. Remarkably metered and free at the same time. Guitar is all half muted.

title: Sincerely
description: Talk wistfully about the past.  Talk hopefully about the future.  Talk about your hopes and fears.  Talk about your neighborhood watch lady.  Talk about your chill tracks!

title: Sinfonia No. 3 in D Major - BWV 789
description: Bach's 3-part invention with a hip beat and bass. The notes are all Bach's, but are not all in the correct order.

title: Sinfonia Number 5
description: J. S. Bach's 3-part invention that I hacked together for music for a "stuffy aristocratic dinner party". Of all the Sinfonias, I think this works the best for that.

title: Sing Along with Jim
description: Peppy yet easy children's music designed to be easy to make up a song to.

title: Skye Cuillin
description: New age and Celtic with super round synths and lots of delay.

title: Sleep and Then
description: Winds descending, strings ascending. Slow, nice.

title: Slow Burn
description: Super nice progressive rock/blues piece with 3 sections.

title: Slow Heat
description: Very simple polyrhythms and polymelodies.

title: Slow Jam
description: Well, this is interesting... Smooth sine bass contrasted with a lovely excited drum machine and then... the magic! Genre bending magic! You're a cool kid right? This is for you. You're welcome. Think 'trap' meets 'R&B' meets 'shoegaze' meets some other genre that is SO COOL there

title: Slow Ska Game Loop
description: Two very different synths bracket the highs and lows of this piece. Loopable for things that require looping.

title: Smash (Sketch)
description: This is NOT a complete piece. It is only a sketch developed as a test for a stage production (repeated many times).  If you only need a few seconds, it is fine. This piece has a harsh ting-y electric piano on top.

title: Smoking Gun
description: Gritty Western feel with a touch of suspense.

title: Smooth Lovin
description: This one got turned up to 11. I started producing this as a parody... then I really started liking it, so I guess it is a pastiche now? Oh, man... I wish there was an allowance for pastiche in copyright like there is for parody.

title: Smooth Move
description: A Simple Bass Groove with High Hat and Snare behind it. The repeated bass line is good for dancing.

title: Smoother Move
description: Super rubato piano solo.

title: Snare Bounce Polka
description: Swing.

title: Sneak 'n Get Caught
description: Low strings / glass harmonica. Wind/String/Percussion diminished chord build with crescendo and sting on the end. (written for Darker Projects' Falcon Banner Episode 4)

title: Sneaky
description: Ascending and descending chromatic scales gives this piece an air of mischief; perfectly suited for a cartoon. It has moments of tenuous fluidity, rapid motion, and a touch of suspense, making it perfect for the classic scene where the hero is sneaking past the sleeping giant.

title: Sneaky Adventure
description: Tight pizz string section, joined by a lone bassoon on the recapitulation.

title: Sneaky Snitch
description: An oboe and a snare drum dance a tantalizing number with the whimsical plucks of a string quartet. The staccato nature of the music suggests walking on tiptoes, while the nasal notes of the oboe flits about almost imperceptibly. In the final minute, the string quartet plays a sim

title: Soaring
description: While not an epic hour-long relaxation juggernaut, Soaring is an excellent relaxation workhorse with just enough mystical qualities to keep it from being truly peaceful.  Imagine a calm monkey hanging out at a remote monastery who, from time to time, will touch a tree - causing t

title: Sock Hop
description: 1950's era simple rock with tremolo lead guitar and vibraphone. Almost surf music.

title: Some Amount of Evil
description: Starts at a fast pace, and slows.

title: Somewhere Sunny
description: Simple, clean guitar duet.

title: Somewhere Sunny (ver 2)
description: This is a longer version of the very popular "Somewhere Sunny". Simple, clean guitar duet.

title: Son of a Rocket
description: Deeply bassy club-style chords.

title: Sonata 17
description: A short piece for small orchestra. The flutes play off the bassoon well. The B section includes a pleasant string theme. This piece culminates in a nice, easy ending.

title: Song of the Volga Boatmen
description: Yo, Heave Ho! The classic theme of difficult drudgery. Based on a Russian folk song.

title: Soporific
description: A laid-back chill, and chilling piece.

title: Southern Gothic
description:
Are you cool? Cool like a vampire planking in a graveyard in Alabama? 
Planking is uncool... so, you gotta be really, REALLY cool to pull off this vibe.
Stomp and clap along to the cooperating banjos!

title: Sovereign
description: Very very good new age piano solo in a minor. You might think 6 minutes is a bit long, but it isn't. Played on a darkly voiced piano. This piece should in no way be offered for free.

title: Sovereign Quarter
description: A re-recording of an older piece of mine on a new sample set of a Steinway Model D. This one is tuned to Quarter Comma Meantone (and not standard Equal Temperament).  In this piece, it gives an unerringly warm feel, as the notes that would be least in tune in this are never used.

title: Space 1990
description: Do you have enough 1990's space music in your collection? Probably not. If you're unclear what 1990s pace music is, just take a listen. A slightly different mix is also available at a faster tempo.

title: Space 1990-B
description: This is about as fast as you can reasonably push such a piece. Smooth and warm.

title: Space Fighter Loop
description: Written as a background loop for a space fighting video game.

title: Space Jazz
description: While working on a video game, the script called for "Space Jazz". I don't know if that is a thing, but this is what I made. Sounds like Space Jazz to me!

title: Space X-plorers
description: Background padding with an open wondrous feel.

title: Spacial Harvest
description: Deep unsettling piece with no repeated themes. Fat, rounded bass drone with very high pitched interest on top.

title: Spacial Winds
description: Clear bowed-bell theme over a sweeping dark digital pad.

title: Spazzmatica Polka
description: Boisterous and nearly obnoxious, this piece will lodge itself in your brain and make you think you?re trapped in an arcade. The polka rhythm is quick and the melody is spastic. Right into the second minute the rhythm drops out and introduces a crazed, comedic melody that continue

title: Special Spotlight
description: So you're producing an interview segment! Problem is most people suck at being interviewed. Like... almost everyone. What do you do? You could send the non-media professional to an improv class, you could do 5 pre-interview coachings, or you could schedule a 3-day "pre-interview"

title: Spellbound
description: Reverbs, reverbs, reverbs! You want reverbs in you music, you got reverbs right here! Room reverbs, plate reverbs, even some spring reverbs! It is amazing! It is incredible! How can there be so much reverb?! So... why... You get a very hollow spooky thin feeling with the reverbs.

title: Spider Eyes
description: Spider Eyes is an eerie soundscape created with distant high strings, dissonant non-percussive piano textures, and alternately tuned bells.  This piece features much sustain and space.

title: Spider's Web
description: Harpsichord in tritones with a bass pedal.

title: Spirit of the Girl
description: There are 54 beads on a Buddhist prayer mala. These are used for counting recitations and chants. There are 54 beats per minute in this song. Coincidence? Sure is. What, you're going through an entire mala cycle in a minute? That's crazy talk! Studies have shown the optimal numbe

title: Split In Synapse
description: A short piece that mixes the symphony with frenzied electronica elements and a dance beat. The horns are blasting and discordant, the synthesizer is manic, the effects disorienting, and the final cresecendo push is loud and forceful.

title: Spring Thaw
description: Simple melody. Something feels amiss here, but in a sort of pleasing way

title: Spy Glass
description: The year is... I have no idea. Timeless. Could be now, could be in the 1950s. Super cool jazz for your hardcore detectives! Also useful for beat poets! Also useful for ennui or boredom! Well, interesting sorts of boredom.

title: Spy Groove
description: Aggressive drum kit sound with warmth added by a B3 organ and conga. Modulation in the final repeat.

title: Stages of Grief
description: That sort of "I'm kind of 'ok', but I'm still standing out in the rain feel". Pretty depressing for being in a major key.

title: Starry
description: C major with a minor IV chord.

title: Starting Out Waltz Allegretto
description: This is more for practicing dance than anything else. It never changes, it never gets interesting. This is important if you don't want to trip over your feet while drilling a dance step.

title: Starting Out Waltz Vivace
description: This is more for practicing dance than anything else. It never changes, it never gets interesting. This is important if you don't want to trip over your feet while drilling a dance step.

title: Static Motion
description: Sharp subtle percussive clicks accompany with otherworldly drone.

title: Stay the Course
description: A low rumble marks the seconds. Out of nowhere comes nothing! Just a continuous ominous force, never seen. You can see the ominous force if you sprinkle some iron filing around.

title: Stealth Groover
description: The constancy of the bass melts into your consciousness, as the syncopation of the high-pitched piano and electric guitar keep the groove flowing. Subtle synthesizer arrangements change the flow of the song and keep it interesting, while the rhythm section is playful and experime

title: Steel and Seething
description: Nice build-up and release. See also: Medusa

title: Steel Rods
description: Smashing on a dumpster while pulling off some imitative counterpoint. Is it a fugue? Nah.

title: Still Pickin
description: Good old fashioned pickin and stompin!

title: Stoic Morning
description: Impromptu. Bright and cheery, but never bubbly. It does change up into minor for a bit.

title: StompDance
description: Starts slowly, and accelerates, ending on a quick note.

title: Stoneworld Battle
description: Giant movie battle sound kicks in at 2:00 with the finale starting at 2:50.

title: Stormfront
description: Intense and reserved, this unrelenting piece of drumming will be well at home in the soundtrack of your summer blockbuster. Super long for splicing.

title: Street Party
description: This is my impression of a tv show street party scene scored by a composer from the 90s. #TexasSharpshooterFallacy

title: Strength of the Titans
description: Oh, this is a big one. Short, but big. There's nothing wrong with either of those things.

title: String Impromptu Number 1
description: Soaring and delicate piece for full string orchestra.

title: Stringed Disco
description: Wah guitar, strings, octave jumping bass, and THE disco beat.

title: Study And Relax
description: Like a worn out record with a mis-punched spindle hole. Thanks, izope! :-)

title: Style Funk
description: Cool, cool funk. Some horns for punctuation.

title: Suave Standpipe
description: You know what's cool? A standpipe in the winter. I imagine this one with a hip mustache and a plaid beret. Enough of the imagery, this is a little downtempo chill piece with lush horn punctuation. Suitable for: walks in the rain, time-lapse videos, sad cooking shows.

title: Sugar Plum Breakdown
description: Just the final part of Tchaikovsky's piece with giant percussion and synths.

title: Sugar Plum Dark Mix
description: Tchaikovsky's dance  from the Nutcracker with lots of percussion and extra choirs.

title: Summer Day
description: Soothing piece with an interesting harmonic left-turn. You got a savage beast? This is just the ticket.

title: Summon the Rawk
description: Double kick drums, aggressive bass... perfect for: entrance music for pro-wrestlers, annoying the neighbors, playing "air drums", long walks on the beach.

title: Sunday Dub
description: This was written for a sneaky-yet-cool scene. The kind where our main character is trailing a subject to find out where they get the amazing cheese they serve at their restaurant. There's a bunch of bits where the paranoid restauranteur turns around unexpectedly and Private Detec

title: Sunflower Dance Party
description: As much fun as you can have with a cowbell! Lots and lots of cowbell.  I wrote this one when I was particularly depressed, and it fixed it. I didn't want it to end, so I kept modulating it; that's why it is longer than most.

title: Sunset at Glengorm
description: Processed piano is featured, leaving a deep uncertain texture. Tempo is highly variable.

title: Sunshine
description: A bright piece with piano and rhythm guitar throughout.  Kit and Bass in the background.  Main melody carried by Piano.

title: Sunshine (version 2)
description: Slightly longer, slightly slower version of "Sunshine"

title: Suonatore di Liuto
description: Simple little background lute piece.

title: Super Circus
description: Circus-type march.

title: Super Friendly
description: Starts easy, builds, and releases easy again. Sort of like a happy triumph. Eucatastrophe, even.

title: Super Polka
description: Super smashing trumpets, and a crazy clarinet! Also guitars and such. Not your oom-pah kind of polka. This is all-out dance.

title: Super Power Cool Dude
description: This piece was built almost entirely with arpeggiators. What does that mean for you? Probably nothing. But holy man! Does this sound like it is from 1983! So, pop a tape of "Flashdance" in your VCR... and then spend like 8 minutes rewinding it... because, apparently your cousin c

title: Supernatural
description: A quick little piece to bring out supernatural elements.

title: Supernatural Radio A
description: If you're looking for that late 40s/early 50s sci-fi or supernatural radio drama - this is your piece. This was rendered on a hammond, using only the drawbars that would make it over the radio (no bass).

title: Surf Inspector
description: Bouncy piece, usable in spy setting.  Stays similar throughout, easily looped, if necessary.

title: Surf Shimmy

title: Suvaco do Cristo
description: Named for a region in Rio, this Brazilian-style carnival piece has a deep dark thickness to it.

title: Sweeter Vermouth
description: The jaunty bass line keeps this short piece moving at a solid pace, while the vibraphone and saxophones play the swinging melody, until the bright, thump of an ending. Use this piece as a slick transition between scenes or for the background to a short scene of drinking, gambling

title: Swimmey Texture
description: Highly processed piano and synths that provide a deep, contemplative texture.

title: Symbiosis
description: Quiet solo piano in 3 parts with additional percussion bit adding in more and more to the end. My normal "feels" that are used to classify pieces are largely inadequate for this piece, as are the genres. In other words... I have no idea what this is.

title: Symmetry
description: This piece has a good beat and you can dance to it... assuming you are a dark, lurking horror with a betentacled face and an urge to consume life forces.

title: Tabuk
description: An epic plodding middle-eastern sounding piece. Grab your camels!

title: Tafi Maradi
description: Percussion beats and shakers instantly make your feet tap, involving you in the tribal experience of ritual kinship. Three sets of call-and-response chanting slide into the forefront of the beat, interspersed with rapid djembe solos to the ending when the dust finally settles.

title: Tafi Maradi no voice
description: Percussion beats and shakers instantly make your feet tap, involving you in the tribal experience of ritual kinship. Three sets of call-and-response chanting slide into the forefront of the beat, interspersed with rapid djembe solos to the ending when the dust finally settles.

title: Take a Chance
description: An out of control epic ride of adventure!

title: Take Me Out to the Ballgame
description: Ballpark organ playing the peppy classic.

title: Take the Lead
description: This is a rough and hard-hitting piece, best used as background music to a stressful, strained scene, or tense and suspenseful content. Heavy distorted guitars begin the song, and at 0:41 the soaring synth leads play the melody while the powerful drums kick in.  A high-pitched pu

title: Takeover of the 8-bit Synths
description: This... uhh... hmm... let's call it 'experimental' piece starts out with vanilla guitar and rock drums, and gets progressively crazier as the 8-bit synths take over the piece. Maximum anarchy starts around the 3-minute point.

title: Tango de Manzana
description: A tango in 2 chords.

title: Taps v2
description: Solo trumpet version of the 1862 military ceremonial piece.

title: Tea Roots
description: Almost straight-up reggae, but with a chinese folk violin in it.

title: Tech Live
description: Interview-Mania! This piece does nothing and goes nowhere. Perfect for an energetic backdrop to your review or interview segments!

title: Tectonic
description: Sister piece to Earth Prelude. Battle sequence.

title: Teddy Bear Waltz

title: Teller of the Tales
description: Simple subtle plucked duet of ancient-inspired origins.

title: Temple of the Manes
description: An ancient-feeling modal piece.

title: Tempting Secrets
description: Starts with a big hit, and then a steady string drone with a beautiful flute line on top. Choirs kick in 2/3 of the way to bring up the mood.

title: Tenebrous Brothers Carnival - Act One
description: This peculiar piece does have a story. If anyone would like to animate it, you'll have to bring your own script. Moderately large changes every minute or so. Accelerando at the end.

title: Tenebrous Brothers Carnival - Act Three
description: Metallic and generally unpleasant... yet I like this piece quite a bit. It gives the impression of a giant mechanical automaton.

title: Tenebrous Brothers Carnival - Act Two
description: A fast deep unyielding sort of waltz-like-thing.

title: Tenebrous Brothers Carnival - Intermission
description: Grooves for a bit, then changes up pretty hard with giant percussion.

title: Tenebrous Brothers Carnival - Mermaid
description: Is she a mer-maid, or is she an illusion! Her enchanting voice will entice, and she is 100% alive! Keep your wits about you, gentlemen - you don't want to be dragged to an unfortunate end.  Very heavy on bass.

title: Tenebrous Brothers Carnival - Prelude
description: Originally released in a special collection as "Delayed Due to Dissonance", this piece is not part of a larger arc.

title: Tenebrous Brothers Carnival - Snake Lady
description: One of the more sultry sideshow acts in the Tenebrous Brothers Carnival, The Snake Lady is a crowd favorite that most never forget, even if they don't remember exactly what happened during the show.

title: Texture for Violincello and Pianoforte No. 2
description: An interesting jumble of cello and some piano fused together to create an eerie and intense piece the likes of which no one has ever heard of...until now.

title: That's a Wrap
description: Sparse music compatible for voice-over. This piece is related to the Rock piece "Welcome to the Show"

title: That Zen Moment
description: I picked up a round metal tongue drum from a local music store a while back, and thought the chords were beautiful. End of story! Enjoy the zen. :-)

title: Thatched Villagers
description: Solid in pace, The Thatched Roof Villagers moves with percussion and a number of flutes and pipes struggling for dominance. The real joy of the piece is halfway through when the tinny dulcimer plays the melody and is then joined by the flutes in melody and harmony. The music is j

title: Thaxted (Holst)
description: Written by Gustav Holst, 1921; Arranged by Kevin MacLeod 2006. Originally published in a hymnbook - this piece took readily to the WWII retrospective type of arrangement.

title: The Bandit
description: Short Theme in two tempos for your bad guy.

title: The Britons
description: Tavern music like from the olden days.

title: The Builder
description: Comedic, free-wheeling fun!

title: The Cannery
description: A giant rousing mechanized heavy piano and heavy percussion piece, mildly reminiscent of Gershiwn or Scott - in 2 small sections.

title: The Chamber
description: Delicate start with a lush ending.

title: The Chase
description: Light and fast. For... well - chase sequences.

title: The Complex
description: Mechanistic, electronic and organic. This piece gets very big around 1:46. (The preview is more 'boomy' than the download.)

title: The Curtain Rises
description: A short bit of fanfare, like the kind that opens movies. Trillerific!

title: The Descent
description: Driving piece without an overpowering melody. Should fit nicely into a lot of scenes.

title: The Dread
description: Background horror music. Electronic. Slow, rumbly, and whiny Moderately unnerving.

title: The Entertainer
description: Scott Joplin composition.

title: The Escalation
description: One really long build. Generally gets faster, fuller and more exciting. Like "Bolero" but for suspense.

title: The Forest and the Trees
description: A peaceful exploration of the interplay between woodwinds weaving through a melody, underscored by soft brass chords. The music evokes scenes of nature, acceptance, and quietude.

title: The Hive
description: Cymbals and synthesizers evoke swarming insects, as whirring and clicking noises abound with heavy reverb.

title: The House of Leaves
description: A simple harp refrain plays a child?s melody, but is torn apart by discordant screeching noises, thumps, growls, and mechanical noises.

title: The Lift
description: A little trance-y and a dance-y, this piece takes a while to develop (like most EDM things these days). The full width of the piece is realized around 1:40. Not so much a drop and a gentle trip down a hill, really - but still satisfying! That note at the end? Surprisingly difficu

title: The Machine Thinks
description: 100% electronic creepiness. Change from round and bleeping to harsh bleeping about 2 minutes in.

title: The North
description: Loopable small composition reminiscent of North American traditional music.

title: The Other Side of the Door
description: A quick and off-color melody on the harp transports you to a mystical eerie world, while a flute plays a sweet melody, and pizzicato strings create a playful undertone. Quite a bit happens in this piece musically, it can be used to complement scenes of mischief, an eerie scene, o

title: The Parting
description: I wrote this one December 27th, 2009 mainly for fun. It is a sweeping quiet piece until the past bit where is opens up a bit.  At 2:06, there is an oddly supported line with a 2+ octave gap between the melody and the supporting bass. At 2:28, the gap is filled triumphantly... It

title: The Path of the Goblin King
description: This is sort of "Spooky Light". It is dark yet playful in a sense. Good for fairy tales or light tension building. It has several small arcs in it - but loops back to the begging.

title: The Path of the Goblin King v2
description: Slightly faster version of the other similarly named piece, this one has an extra sense of urgency, but still retains the mystery and wonder bits.

title: The Pyre
description: Vaguely medieval overtones. The opening section repeats in the second half with violins added.

title: The Reveal
description: Starts with cellos, adds horn, clarinet, English horn, contra-tuba - to a final sustained chord. Slow. Thin yet satisfying.

title: The Rule
description: I sort of regal opening brass fanfare. It is meant to join at the end with another piece of music... which has not been written yet. This works as a stand-alone opening for most anything.

title: The Second Coming
description: A sound track piece with Kit and Trombones/French Horns throughout.  This piece includes sections from a public domain (librivox) reading of "The Second Coming."

title: The Second Coming Instrumental
description: A sound track piece with Kit and Trombones/French Horns throughout.

title: The Show Must Be Go
description: Sort of inspired by the 1930s, and sort of inspired by all-out weird. Definitely recommend taking a listen to this piece. Make sure you get to the 1 minute mark... fun times trumpet playing await! I personally enjoy how the clarinet play tries to follow the trumpet player - doesn

title: The Sky of our Ancestors
description: We reflect, we dream, we are born. We gather together, we smile, we eat potato salads. We remember, we invent, muddle mint for our mojitos. We greet, we listen, we appreciate NetFlix. We collect coins and stamps... for some reason. We mix up the names of our children with the nam

title: The Small
description: Simple polyrhythms in a very small piece. Get it? Small!? Epsilon!?? Yeah... no worries. The fifth of a series.

title: The Snow Queen
description: Sort of exciting and sort of spooky in that fairy tale sort of way. This is one of my favorite pieces of late. Good interplay of instruments. You can listen to this one over and over. Handy, because it does loop back to the beginning. Major build starting at 1:50 or so.

title: The Voices
description: Almost comforting pad, were it not for the inhuman voice-like punctuations.

title: The Way Out
description: Understated intensity with a hair of creepiness.

title: The Whip
description: The shorter theme written for the opening of The Whip Podcast. Starts off quick with a short drum roll, then continues with guitar.  Guitar used throughout, ends with a fade out using Kit.  Bass in the background only.

title: The Whip (Extended Version)
description: The extended version of the show theme written for The Whip Podcast.  Aggressive, hip, theme.  Slow fade out at the end.  This version can be looped easier than the shorter version.

title: Theme for Harold (var. 1)
description: Simple simple 8-bit theme. This is the laziest and slowest of the three. It was originally written by a puppet, so mostly black keys, which are easier for a puppet to play.

title: Theme for Harold (var. 2)
description: Simple simple 8-bit theme. This is the mid-tempo version of the three. It was originally written by a puppet, so mostly black keys, which are easier for a puppet to play.

title: Theme for Harold (var. 3)
description: Simple simple 8-bit theme. This is the fastest "Boss Level" version of the three. It was originally written by a puppet, so mostly black keys, which are easier for a puppet to play.

title: There is Romance
description: Slow and poignant, this piece is excellent for depicting childhood love, the swelling love of adolescence, or the tender caresses of old age. The simple, elegant melody is exceptionally suitable to weddings, faith services, or as a theme to a story of lasting love.

title: There It Is
description: Very quick and jovial, this brass heavy piece has a guitar riff that sticks in the brain, but ends suddenly. Useful for a quick theme introduction, transition, or for a fast and exciting commercial.

title: Thief in the Night
description: Laid-back, grooving, and cool. Did I mention cool? You need a cool piece. That is a statement you NEED a cool piece. Lucky for you, this IS a cool piece. Super clean production will allow this piece to fit into most things. I'd personally use this piece for a super badass charact

title: Thinking Music
description: Comedic "hard thinking" music. Chances are you won't need the entire piece if you are making a film. I made it so you can cut it up into different sounding sections of various seriousness. If you're using it for a video game, everything flows together well, or you could loop sect

title: Thinking of You
description: Nice piece for a narrative voice-over of good times past, present or future.

title: Thinking Out Loud
description: Piano looped digital electronica hybrid. I started this piece in 2

title: This House
description: Delightfully creepy, this piece is really difficult to listen to without squirming a bit. I blame the violins... as we all should. Perfect for any scene where something just ain't right!

title: Thunder Dreams
description: This is more of a chordal soundscape than a drone. There is a little bit of hope here and there, but it is tempered with a deep sadness. Probably useful after a loss. Beautiful, horrible.

title: Thunderbird
description: Wikipedia describes the Thunderbird as "a supernatural bird of power and strength". It will also ask you to disambiguate it from the automobile made by Ford from 1955 to 2005. I'm sure it was a nice car. I've never owned one. But there were a lot of them! The late 70's Thunderbir

title: Thunderhead
description: Native American drumming. The branch rattle is reminiscent of thunder. Tempo picks up about halfway through.

title: Tiki Bar Mixer
description: How to make Tiki Drinks: Add rum. Add fruit juice. Add other rum. Add different fruit juice. Add another rum. Add some other juice thing. Top with crushed ice. Garnish with umbrella, flowers, pineapple, watermelon, small plastic dinosaurs, and sugar cane. Light on fire.

title: Tikopia
description: The feel of this percussion pieces switches from straight to swing several times, but always has a round wooden sound to it.

title: Time Passes
description: Bittersweet and somewhat dark; ends brightly on an open major chord.

title: Tiny Fugue
description: A very short fugal theme. (3-part imitative counterpoint)

title: To the Ends
description: Horns used in the background.  Main melodies carried by clarinet and strings.  Starts off bright, ends darker.

title: Toccata and Fugue in D Minor
description: J. S. Bach's most famous organ piece. BWV 565. (Beckerath German baroque pipe organ)

title: Too Cool
description: You know when you watch a vampire movie and then you walk out into the real world, but you're still sort of in the fictional world because it looked like the real world... and that's where you are now. I call this Persistence of Fiction, and it feels awesome! Capture some fiction

title: Touching Moments Five - Circle
description: A simple tour through every major key in order. Arpeggiated with some connecting melodic notes.

title: Touching Moments Four - Melody
description: More melodic than most of the pieces presented here - can be distracting, or can be just what you're looking for. Famous from the Sad Fairy Dress-up game.

title: Touching Moments One - Pulse
description: Open and airy. A classic "touching moment" style. Performance imperfections are exaggerated to give a more "choked up" feel.

title: Touching Moments Three - Deeper
description: A more 'gutsy' piece that explores more of the keyboard, and provides a more grounded and open feel.

title: Touching Moments Two - Higher
description: Only notes from the very highest registers of the piano are used in this. It can cut through ambient noise and still provide a presence.

title: Touching Story
description: Very very slow and changeable.

title: Townie Loop
description: Welcome to the town! If you have anything to sell, just put it in the box. The general store sells seeds. There is a Mountain Totem in the mountains. You can have a drink at the Iridium Bar. I need to tend to my giant melons now. That is not a euphemism. Bye!

title: Tranquility
description: A calming meditative piece rendered on 4 iPhones using the Balls, Bloom, Bebot, and Ocarina applications.

title: Tranquility Base
description: Super chill, meditative, and massively long drone. The preview is cut to three minutes, but the entire download is 18 minutes, and more than 42 meg. Please be patient.

title: Transition One
description: Small calm transition; descending wind ensemble blending to ascending string ensemble.

title: Trepidation
description: Background horror music. Solo piano; low and loud.

title: Trio for Piano, Cello, and Clarinet
description: More contemplative than outright depressing. Tempo is highly variable, so don't count on it if you have to synch to something. I didn't know there was a tradition of writing for this instrumentation. It works very well.

title: Trio for Piano Violin and Viola
description: An unfinished trio in 2 main parts.

title: Trips It
description: A driving electronic piece.  Kit is dominant throughout the piece.  Choir has brief moments about 55 secs in, and re-emerging for a heavier role towards the end half of the piece.

title: Trouble
description: Diminished chords, tremolo You'll recognize them.

title: Trouble with Tribals
description: Another exciting guerrilla warfare planning meeting, and Parker didn't bring the coffee. I'm starting to get annoyed with Parker more and more these days. Sure, the new "cape cod style" curtains look great in the mud blinds, but I'm not into the satin obelisk in the middle of our

title: Truth in the Stones
description: New age music. You know what is cool about New Age music? Low ambitions. It wants to do a simple thing, and then does it. No crazy counterpoint. No complicated harmonic structures. Just a simple simple thing. Like if Tetris was all those long blocks. Man, that would be great.

title: Truth of the Legend
description: Solo voice along with a small choir and giant percussion section. Ends in a sort of ethereal mode.

title: Twisted
description: A modern take on a 1970’s rock style.

title: Twisting
description: Let's talk about why so much film music sounds like this. The construction allows any part to be muted and otherwise sculpted around the dialog without the loss of a theme or motive energy. There isn't really a theme to lose. You can't hum this one easily. There is a lot of varia

title: Two Finger Johnny
description: Remember the old Casio and Yamaha "auto accompaniment" keyboards? This is a super-simple and freakishly-delightful terrible piece of music.

title: Two Together
description: Sparkly open voicings.

title: Ujangong Mix
description: An epic clash of genre that feigns coherence. Based on the Public Domain 1904 recording of "Ujangong (Mask Dance)" from New Guinea. But with a swing bass and slicing techno chunk in 3/4 time.

title: Ultra Polka
description: I tried to do an EDM piece using one of my new accordions... turns out, accordion just doesn't have the fast attack needed to do fast electronic things. The melody and chords were written for a diatonic button box, but I was never able to get the live recording to work. No worrie

title: Ultralounge
description: You hip? You really hip? Oh, yeah you are! This piece comes from the coolest hippest parts of solar system... from a 1960s pad on the moon. Oh yeah. Dig it, man... dig it. The uncompressed download also comes with an even more chill mix.

title: Umbrella Pants
description: If naming tracks is so easy, you try it! Possibly sneaking, possibly comedic dialog, possibly comedic dialog while sneaking... 1,

title: Unanswered Questions
description: The solid beat and dark melody reverberate, giving the simplicity of this single-instrument piece the feeling of mounting tension and unease. Useful for a documentary showing pain, poverty, or imprisonment.

title: Undaunted
description: Big big drums pushing a big cinematic feel.

title: Unease
description: Background horror music. Solo midrange piano.

title: Unholy Knight
description: Oh geez, there's lots of notes in this one. The end of this piece is just woodwinds by themselves, and they are super cool. So often the percussion just takes over these pieces, even though there are some beautiful parts that get attention directed away from them.

title: Unity
description: Big driving piano and drums piece for action goodness!

title: Universal
description: Floating and grounding, this piece has a lot of bass guts but still a lot of reach on the high end. Perfect for retrospectives, automobile time lapses, drunken frat parties (black and white), and studying montages.

title: Unlight
description: This piece is actively painful. It is ugly and nasty and dirty - about as much as you can be using exactly one orchestra. Seriously, there are occasional bits where there are notes - but mostly, it is just... uhh...

title: Unnatural Situation
description: Piano with a tape delay and lots of dark colour in the background.

title: Unpromised
description: Thin piece with surprising chordal structures in the second A section.

title: Unseen Horrors
description: I originally wrote this as a piece for theramin, but I think it works better without.

title: Unwritten Return
description: Dreamy and edgy; Not a combination you often find, and yet - here it is. The ambiguous and slippery nature of the piece are a wonderful thing. Perfect for scoring a character where the audience is unsure of them. Could be good? Could be evil? WE DON'T KNOW!

title: Up on a Housetop
description: Super-bouncy holiday sing-along.

title: Upbeat Forever
description: Ska! Ska! Ska! At least, I hope it gives that impression. Works pretty well for a lively background to most anything! This was written for an improv comedy group... so they would have something reasonable to sing to - if an audience member suggests it.

title: Urban Gauntlet
description: Action-y intense like percussion based piece. Need to defuse a bomb while riding in a pedi-cab? This should work well for that. Or anything where tension needs to be maintained.

title: Vadodora
description: Quite a hip little tune. Also available without the melody.

title: Vadodora Chill Mix
description: Quite a hip little tune. Also available witha cutting melody.

title: Valse Gymnopedie
description: This is Gymnopedie #1 from Erik Satie (1888), but it has a beat and you can dance to it.

title: Vanes
description: A disturbingly sweet melody on an electric piano is accompanied with a slow and steady beat. Synth sounds undulate in the background, fighting for prominence. They ultimately melt away, leaving the piano melody to play one last despair-filled refrain.

title: Vanishing
description: Several distinct moods are found in this piece. They start at 0:00, 1:23, 2:31, and 3:10. They do all flow into each other, but can be sliced apart pretty easily. Some are quite beautiful, so stick with this piece. Excellent piece for filmmakers!

title: Variation on Egmont
description: Kind of techno, with a mix in of themes from Beethoven's overture as played on piano.

title: Vegas Glitz
description: This sounds happier than anything with parallel chords should.

title: Verano Sensual
description: This one was designed to be played at low volumes under people doing things like talking or fixing broken PS4s. Spicy, spicy broken PS4s. Mmmm....

title: Very Low Note
description: Just a very low note (a C) to be used as a bed for any very unnerving and dark scene.

title: Vibe Ace
description: Starts more synthy ends more organic.

title: Vicious
description: Bit of swing in your rap? Sure! Why not! I like swing... but NOT TOO MUCH! Just here and there... you know, to alleviate the monotony. Sort of like that one teacher you had in Social Studies that unexpectedly did something cool - like play a game - but only twice a year... and th

title: Video Dungeon Boss
description: This a simple "fake bit" composition. I used very simple oscillators for everything, and then processed it quite a bit. Made for a dungeon level for an old-school video game. Loopable. Video Dungeon Crawl is similar but slower.

title: Video Dungeon Crawl
description: This a simple "fake bit" composition. I used very simple oscillators for everything, and then processed it quite a bit. Made for a dungeon level for an old-school video game. Loopable. Video Dungeon Boss is similar but faster.

title: Village Consort
description: Picture a pixellated medieval village... cause that's what this is. It is the kind of music we think they played back in the day. It is not historically. But I'm okay with that, because we also didn't have lich-kings, lich-mages, lich-illithids, lich-warriors, or lich-archers. We

title: Village Dawn
description: Light piece in 5/8 time with a Lydian subsection.

title: Villainous Treachery

title: Villainous Treachery - Distressed
description: The melody for this piece is in the bass keys, while the high notes play a headache-splitting constant rhythm. At the one-minute mark the high-pitched notes drop several octaves to play a crunched staccato before returning to the previous theme. The last thirty seconds feature dr

title: Vintage Education
description: Intended to imitate the style of the 1970's educational programming.

title: Virtutes Instrumenti
description: Based on 11th century sacred music, this piece can set you way way back in time almost instantly. Several faster and slower sections are available during this piece.

title: Virtutes Vocis
description: Based on 11th century sacred music, this pieces carries melodies only, and no words.

title: Vision of Persistence
description: Rhythmically driven simple piece, high and sweet.

title: Vivacity
description: Happy, peppy, vibraphone piece. Sounds like the late 1950's or early 1960's.

title: Voice Over Under
description: This is a piece of music classified as "GNDN". Goes Nowhere. Does Nothing. It sort of sits there and just repeats mild variants. There isn't even an ending.  Yet, this was all on purpose. This piece was designed for keeping energy in news reports or review segments where there is

title: Volatile Reaction
description: 7/4 time, blasting brass, pounding percussion. Suitable for fights, evil, or a calm day at the park... in hell.

title: Voltaic
description: You know that sound that was big in 80s dance music with that sort of galloping doo-do-do-DAH-do-do-doo-do-do-DAH thing? This has a thing like that, but in really, really complex drum sound. You need to wait until 16 seconds in to hear what the doo-do-do-DAH-do-do-doo-do-do-DAH s

title: Vortex
description: Blatting brass ensemble. Uneven phrasing.

title: Voxel Revolution
description: Is it chiptunes? Nope. Is it 80s? Nope. We had to wait 40 years for this stupid fusion! 40 Years!!! It is really happy, though. Like when an underdog video game character is doing a level-up montage, or that song that plays in a 13 year old's head when they get an extra mozzarell

title: Vulcan
description: A mystical piece for Flutes, Bells, and Percussion.  Disjointed melodic flute in counterpoint with lower fluttery flutes, plodding  percussion, and shimmering bells. Same texture throughout piece.

title: Wagner Bridal Chorus
description: The classic "here come the bride" piece written by Wagner for the opera Lohengrin. This is about as traditional a performance as you can get.

title: Wagner Bridal Chorus - piano
description: A newer piano variation on Wagner's Bridal Chorus. It leaves out some of the less familiar middle section, and changes up a few chords while retaining the melody.

title: Wagon Wheel
description: Super jaunty quick tune with 3 distinct parts. The main theme starts in the beginning, Super syncopated theme starts at about a minute in, and the industrial comedy theme starts at 1:30 or so.

title: Wagon Wheel - Electronic
description: Super jaunty quick tune with 3 distinct parts. The main theme starts in the beginning, Super syncopated theme starts at about a minute in, and the industrial comedy theme starts at 1:30 or so.

title: Wah Game Loop
description: Just a simple funk/rock piece for looping anonymously in the background of things. Organ seems a bit nasal. hmm...

title: Walking Along
description: Written as a laid-back background for a film where a calming feel was needed.

title: Wallpaper
description: Very very clean mix that is non-offensive on almost all fronts. Good spectral distribution - nice lows and highs. 2 catchy synth lines sort of fight for attention, leaving you to ignore them both after a while.

title: Waltz of the Carnies
description: Creepy off-putting circus music. Also features some honking horns later in the piece.

title: Waltz of Treachery
description: Light but dim. Nice for a 'classy' villain with a plan.

title: Waltz Primordial
description: Featuring the genuine Nordic Metal talents of Alexander Nakarada.

title: Waltz (Tschikovsky Op. 40)
description: Opus 40; Number 9. Written 1878. Recorded 2005.

title: Water Droplets on the River
description: 6/8 piece meant to be reminiscent of nice memories from long ago.

title: Water Lily
description: Simple and elegant.

title: Water Prelude
description: Smooth background music... Float-y feeling.

title: Waunobe March
description: A simple march as played by a semi-competent 23-piece ensemble.

title: We Got Trouble
description: Super action, but still a bit restrained. Quite a long cue with a few changes on the inside.

title: We Wish you a Merry Christmas
description: Starts out slowly and accelerates as it builds.

title: Weight of Responsibility
description: Brass ensemble with a slight bit of strings. Deliberate chorale sounding, free conducted. Evocative of a sense of nobility and weariness. Loopable.

title: Welcome to HorrorLand
description: Welcome to HorrorLand! Please keep all arms, legs, and eyestalks inside the vehicle at all times. All exits are clearly marked. There are no exits. Do not attempt to leave HorrorLand. This will end badly for everyone. Please note: it will end badly if you do not attempt to leave

title: Welcome to the Show
description: A one-chord wonder designed to open a show. It has a long lead out for fading. Modulation about halfway through.

title: Wepa
description: Need an upbeat vaguely urban-sounding piece to run under your video outro? That's why I made this! You're welcome.

title: Werq
description: This is destined to be a podcast theme. If you're starting a podcast, get this now before someone else does. You know it's perfect. Plus is is easy to type the title in your credits. I'm looking out for you, podcaster! All hail the Podfather, Adam Curry. Yes, that Adam Curry. Yes

title: Western Streets
description: An all percussion tension-sustaining piece... More chaotic than symmetric, but enough repeated themes to keep it cohesive.

title: Wet Riffs
description: Solo bass with a looping pedal. Very very slow. Super nice. Starts with the highs, and builds interest in the bass.

title: What Child is This
description: Very very high and thin.

title: What Is Love
description: What is love? Apparently, it is an odd mix of 1980's synthy love songs and modern trap beats. I don't think there is anything like this out there... which may be a fine thing - or I've just invented a genre. Crooner-Synth Trap-Pop.

title: What You Want
description: Super aggressive distorted piece with vocal effects.

title: What You Want (version 2)
description: Same as the other version, but with no intelligible vocals.

title: When The Wind Blows

title: Whimsy Groove
description: Lighter and more fun small drum ensemble. Tumba, Conga, Quinto, Bells, and lots of Marimba.

title: Whiskey on the Mississippi
description: With a jumping bass and off-beat syncopation, this is straight from Memphis? Beale Street. The Hammond organ and electric guitar play together as longtime friends, while the melody changes hands from guitar to organ to electric piano.

title: White
description: Easy flowing with highly differentiated right and left hand parts.

title: White Lotus
description: Interesting new age sort of piece, that meets you halfway in the beginning with a lush, but brittle metallic soundscape. As it progresses - the metals fall away, and you're left with a bed of pure sine waves, and a piano tuned exactly to go along with them.

title: Who Likes to Party
description: There are 70s bits, 80s bits, 90s bits.... all soft of mashed up in a salad-mash-soup-like thing.  Super crisp dance mix.

title: Wholesome
description: Nothing but good, wholesome instruments here. None of those dirty electric guitars, synths, drum kits, harps, sackbuts, or pipe organs. Heh, organs.

title: Willow and the Light
description: Think dark overgrown forest with overtones of magic in it. This one can loop perfectly - if you cut it right.

title: Wind of the Rainforest
description: Would you believe this is computer-generated? I would believe that. I would totally believe that.

title: Windswept
description: A relaxed guitar and strings piece for the denouement of a story or exposition of the scenic outdoors. The guitar is peaceful as the strings gently build in prominence. The tempo is regular overall, but slows down in key moments to build a sense of tranquility.

title: Winner Winner!
description: Hard to get more fun than this. Seriously, it is insane fun.

title: Winter Chimes
description: Interesting piano solo with a repeated pedal in the right hand. Counterpoint on the final repeat.

title: Winter Reflections
description: A calming piece rendered on 3 iPhones using the Bloom, Bebot, and Balls applications.

title: Wish Background
